description: KayKit V2 test catalog. Logical mesh IDs must match DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2 in UE.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: Baseline UE Engine BasicShapes Plane in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Baseline flat tile plane for normal floor, grass, path and bridge surfaces.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: Baseline UE Engine BasicShapes Plane used for water in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Flat water surface plane. It keeps water as a separate logical mesh ID.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: Baseline UE Engine BasicShapes Cube in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Baseline full tile wall block used for comparison with KayKit wall meshes.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: Baseline UE proxy door mesh in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Simple door or gate proxy used as a baseline for the KayKit door.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Floor.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: KayKit floor mesh for a visible tile surface. It is used to test a floor mesh instead of a simple plane.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Floor_Dirt.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: KayKit dirt floor mesh for a rough outdoor ground tile.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Primitive_Floor.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Simple KayKit primitive floor tile. It is useful as a controlled floor geometry test.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Primitive_Wall.fbx. Registry enables connected wall assembly for this simple wall mesh.
meshes.description: Simple wall segment for horizontal, vertical, corner, T and cross connections. Its local long axis should be X.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Wall.fbx imported as a Static Mesh. Connected wall assembly is disabled.
meshes.description: KayKit full wall mesh for a fixed wall section. It is not procedurally split into wall arms.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Wall_Half.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: KayKit half wall mesh for a low wall section. It uses manual orientation and does not use connected wall assembly.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Wall_Doorway.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: A fixed wall with a doorway opening. It is a structure mesh, not an interactive door Actor.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Door_A.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: KayKit wooden door mesh. It should align to adjacent walls and use a floor underlay.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Primitive_Stairs.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Full tile stairs mesh. The Builder does not infer rising direction, so rotation is manual.

meshes.ue_mesh_note: KayKit Primitive_Slope.fbx imported as a Static Mesh and assigned in DA_GlobalMeshRegistryV2.
meshes.description: Fixed direction slope mesh for testing non-flat structure placement and underlay.
